recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add Encounter to retired workflow-instantiatesCanonical or to request-only workflow-compliesWith. If the PA EpisodeOfCare suggestion needs more than the existing workflow-episodeOfCare extension family, treat it as separate Extension Pack/work-group work.
issue_request: FHIR-29665 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to support linking an Encounter to an ActivityDefinition through the workflow instantiates relationship, with final application interpreted through the FHIR-29261 split of workflow instantiates into more specific extensions.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 2ee637a94c1abc09d0ab102e1f1a655a7292322d together with FHIR-29261 and FHIR-32897. That implementation added Encounter to workflow-adheresTo and workflow-triggeredBy in the then-core workflow extension spreadsheet and explicitly did not add it to workflow-compliesWith because compliesWith is for Requests.
additional_context: FHIR-29261 controls the request/event split: compliesWith is Request, adheresTo is Event, and triggeredBy is Request|Event. PA minutes supported Encounter and also suggested EpisodeOfCare, while the final seed resolution and application were scoped to Encounter. Later commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed concrete extension rows from the core R5 source; the current Extension Pack source carries the authoritative StructureDefinitions.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No core source change is needed because the current core checkout only retains workflow extension metadata/notes, and the Extension Pack definitions already include Encounter on workflow-adheresTo and workflow-triggeredBy while leaving workflow-compliesWith request-only and workflow-instantiatesCanonical retired.
